Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose. We specialize in leading-edge electronic product development, with hardware, embedded software, FPGA/ASIC, and signal integrity teams working together to design and deliver next-generation products for clients in emerging technology markets.
 Position Overview/Mandate: 
 The Senior Signal Integrity and Power Integrity Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring the performance, reliability, and compliance of high-speed electronic systems designed by Fidus. You will lead and support SI/PI analysis from early architecture through final validation, working closely with hardware designers, PCB layout, FPGA, and system teams to optimize signal quality and power distribution.
 This role is ideal for someone who thrives on solving complex high-speed challenges, enjoys working across multiple industries, and takes pride in delivering robust, production-ready designs backed by strong analytical and lab validation skills.
 You'll contribute to projects ranging from evaluation boards and reference designs to high-speed backplanes and systems involving DDR memory interfaces and SERDES, engaging from early concept and stack-up definition through simulation, layout guidance, lab validation, and final product release.
 Make an Impact with US: 
 At Fidus, you'll work on high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems, often using emerging technologies before they reach the broader market. You'll collaborate across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design as part of cross-functional teams delivering real products for our clients.
 In practice, that means contributing to projects across Communications, Aerospace & Defence, Life Sciences & Medical Devices, Space & Satellite, Industrial Automation, Automotive, and Semiconductor engagements. You won't be limited to a single product or industry—your work will follow the technology, not just one roadmap.
 What You’ll Be Doing: 
 Lead PCB layer stack-up design and optimization 
 Perform waveform integrity, crosstalk, timing, eye diagram, and jitter analysis 
 Conduct power integrity analysis including DC IR drop and decoupling strategy optimization 
 Model insertion and return loss and support EMC analysis 
 Use industry tools such as Cadence Sigrity, HSPICE, ADS, HFSS, and Hyperlynx for simulation and analysis 
 Support and execute lab validation using TDR, vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and high-speed oscilloscopes 
 Estimate turnkey projects and execute work from concept through development, lab testing, and final product delivery 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams including hardware, layout, FPGA, and system engineers to ensure SI/PI best practices are embedded early in the design cycle
 Who You are: 
 MS or PhD in Electrical/Electronics Engineering 
 Minimum five (5) years of experience designing and analyzing high-speed circuits or RF structures 
 Strong background in signal integrity, power integrity, electromagnetics, RF, antennas, or EMC 
 Hands-on experience with high-speed interfaces such as DDR memory and SERDES 
 Proficiency with SI/PI simulation and analysis tools such as Cadence Sigrity, HSPICE, ADS, HFSS, and Hyperlynx 
 Solid lab validation experience using tools such as TDR, vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and high-speed oscilloscopes 
 Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with customers and cross-functional teams 
 Comfortable adapting to new technologies and working across diverse industries 
 Committed to disciplined engineering practices and delivering high-quality designs
 Embraces AI as part of a modern engineering toolkit
 Location and travel: Position is based in Canada. Travel may be required domestically and internationally to support customer engagements and project delivery.
 This position may require access to export-controlled information. Candidates will be required to complete background checks and security screening under Canada's Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and may also be required to obtain a security clearance under the Contract Security Program (CSP) administered by Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC, formerly PWGSC).
 This role is an evergreen position.

 Skillshare is an online learning community whose mission is to connect curious, lifelong learners everywhere – and, in so doing, build a more creative, more generous, and more prosperous world.  About the role 
 As an engineer at Skillshare, you'll help shape how teachers share their expertise, how students discover and watch content they love, and how our platform evolves for the future. This role sits at the foundation of our backend, including our domain model, service architecture, event backbone, and the conventions other engineers build on top of.
 We work in a TypeScript monorepo built around Domain-Driven Design, hexagonal architecture, and Clean Architecture principles. Our services are built with NestJS, our API is GraphQL, our data lives in Postgres behind Prisma, and our infrastructure runs on GCP.
 We're looking for someone who thinks deeply about systems and boundaries, is comfortable making and documenting architectural decisions, and can leave behind a codebase that other engineers can understand and build upon.
 AI is also a core part of how our engineering team works. We use tools like Claude Code throughout the development process, and we're looking for someone who knows how to effectively direct, review, and improve AI-generated work while remaining accountable for the architecture, quality, and end result.
 What You'll Do: 
 Shape our backend architecture and domain model , defining clear bounded contexts, aggregates, domain events, and service boundaries that reflect how the business actually works.
 Build and evolve TypeScript/NestJS services using Domain-Driven Design and ports-and-adapters patterns, keeping business logic isolated from infrastructure.
 Own key backend contracts , including our GraphQL API, Postgres data models, and the patterns we use to evolve them safely as the product grows.
 Build reliable event-driven systems , designing for durability, idempotency, retries, and the realities of distributed systems.
 Use an AI coding harness as a core development tool , directing and reviewing generated code while improving the context, standards, tests, and guardrails that make AI-assisted development more effective.
 Raise the bar for engineering quality through thoughtful code review, testing, technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and clear decision records.
 Turn ambiguous product needs into well-designed systems, partnering with product and engineering teammates to model problems, make tradeoffs, and ship meaningful work.
 Work within our weekly delivery cadence , breaking foundational work into meaningful increments that can move from Monday goals to Friday demos.
 8+ years of experience building backend systems in production, with deep TypeScript and Node.js experience and the judgment that comes from owning and maintaining systems you've designed.
 Deep, hands-on experience with Domain-Driven Design . You've applied DDD to real, complex domains and are comfortable defining bounded contexts, aggregate boundaries, value objects, and domain events. You understand hexagonal architecture / ports and adapters, including both the value of that separation and when the additional indirection is worth it.
 Strong experience designing and owning GraphQL APIs , including schema modeling, batching and the N+1 problem, pagination, error semantics, and evolving a live schema without breaking clients.
 Experience designing event-driven and distributed systems . You can reason concretely about at-least-once delivery, idempotency, ordering, retries, transactional boundaries, and patterns such as the transactional outbox.
 Strong relational data modeling and SQL fundamentals , including schema design, migrations against live data, indexing, transaction boundaries, and designing read and write paths intentionally.
 Experience with NestJS or significant production experience in another modern Node.js backend framework such as Fastify, Express, Hono, AdonisJS, or tRPC, with the ability to ramp quickly on NestJS.
 You're highly proficient with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or a comparable agentic coding harness. AI isn't occasional autocomplete in your workflow. You're comfortable directing an agent through meaningful engineering work while owning the architecture, context, review, and final result. You review generated code critically and know how to catch plausible-but-wrong implementations, missed edge cases, and broken invariants.
 You have strong testing instincts . You know how to design systems that are testable at the domain level, use fast implementations or test doubles appropriately, and reserve integration testing for the seams where systems actually integrate.
 You communicate technical decisions exceptionally well in writing and visually . Architecture decision records, domain glossaries, system diagrams, data and event flows, and technical standards are part of how you work, not documentation you add after the fact.
 You operate with a high degree of autonomy . You can take an ambiguous product or technical problem, model it, make thoughtful architectural tradeoffs, sequence the work, and drive it through completion without waiting for a fully written spec.
 You can maintain working-hour overlap with our US-based team until at least 1:00 PM Eastern each day. This is when much of our live collaboration happens, including code review, pairing, Monday goal-setting, and Friday demos. Outside of that window, we work largely asynchronously, so strong written communication and leaving clear context behind are important.
 Nice to Haves: 
Our current stack includes NestJS, GraphQL, Postgres, Prisma, GCP, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Pulumi, Nx, Bun, and Zod . You don't need to have worked with every tool in our stack.  We'd also be excited about experience with:
 Building or shaping codebases specifically for AI coding agents, including context files, agent rules, MCP servers, hooks, or automated development guardrails.
 Fine-grained authorization or relationship-based access control systems such as OpenFGA, Zanzibar-style ReBAC, or OPA.
 Running transactional outbox patterns, change data capture, or stream processing in production.
 Infrastructure as Code and cloud-native deployment environments.
 Monorepo architecture, developer tooling, generators, or custom plugins.
 Schema-driven contracts and runtime validation.

KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a Social Media Manager to join our team! You will own organic social for both brands end to end across every social channel. You decide what each account is for, who it should bring in and what content grows it. Then you plan it, create it, publish it every day and adjust based on what the numbers tell you. This isn't a role for keeping the lights on: we want someone who will transform our socials and turn them into a super-engaged community that people actually want to be part of.
 You report to our Influencers & Partnerships Manager and have a designer for bigger creative pieces, but the thinking is yours and you're strong on graphics and short-form video yourself. We are looking for someone with 2+ years running organic social for a DTC or consumer brand, who has personally created and published the content and can show the accounts they grew and the numbers they moved.
 The mission of this role
 Own organic social for KittySpout and DoggySpout end to end across all social media channels. Success is accounts that keep growing and reach people who have never heard of us, with content created and published every day that grows an active, engaged community.
 Who are we?
 KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.
 What is our culture like & who is a good fit?
 Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:
 Better Everyday – test a new format, hook or post style every week, keep what works and improve the calendar and reporting along the way.
 Speed Is King – get a trend live the day it's spotted, publish on time every day and answer the community within 24 hours.
 Work Smart – use AI and tools so your time goes to strategy and creating: batch and schedule posts ahead, let Claude draft hook and caption variations, and automate the Monday report.
 Overdeliver – bring new content ideas to the Influencers & Partnerships Manager before being asked, and tell the team fast when something flops and what you're changing.
 If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it. 
 If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.
 Outcomes (what success looks like)
 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date. 
 Grow the audience on both brands – follower growth by brand and platform (Instagram, TikTok and Facebook insights)
 Reach people who have never heard of us – reach and non-follower reach per post by brand (platform insights)
 Content people save and share – saves, shares and engagement rate by brand (platform insights)
 Publish daily to plan on both brands – posts published per week per brand vs the content calendar (scheduling tool)
 An active, responsive community – comments and DMs answered within 24 hours, Facebook group activity (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok)
 Key Objectives
 Own the organic content strategy for KittySpout and DoggySpout across all social media channels.
 Plan the content calendar one week ahead per brand and platform, mixing content for the existing community with content built to reach new audiences.
 Create and publish every day: write the hooks and captions, shoot and edit short-form video, and design day-to-day graphics and stories.
 Spot trends daily and get trend content live the same day.
 Turn the creator and UGC content from our creator programs into organic posts that perform.
 Run the community: comments, DMs, our Facebook group and tagged mentions.
 Read the data every week and act on it: double down on what works and drop what doesn't.
 Fully remote, full-time
 Native-level written English
 Hands-on Organic Social: 2+ years personally running organic social for a DTC or consumer brand – creating and publishing the content yourself, not just approving it or managing an agency.
 Proof: Accounts you grew and numbers you moved. We will ask for this.
 Multi-brand, Multi-platform: You can run two brands across every social channel and tailor content to each instead of copying the same post everywhere.
 Design: You build clean, on-brand graphics and stories in Canva, Figma or similar without waiting on a designer.
 Hooks, Captions & Video: You write hooks that stop the scroll and shoot and edit short-form video to a solid standard.
 Trend Spotting: You're on TikTok and Instagram every day and spot trends before they peak.
 Data-driven: You read saves, shares, reach and engagement and change what you make because of it.
 Time Zone: Overlap with the US and Canada, where most of our audience is.
 No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work.
 Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
 Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.
 Bonus points: pet, home or wellness brand experience; working with creators or UGC.
 Accountabilities
 What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week. 
 Content strategy and calendar – Own the organic content strategy for both brands, plan next week's calendar per brand and platform and get it approved with the Influencers & Partnerships Manager, and get trend content live the same day.
 Create and publish daily – Write the hooks and captions, shoot and edit short-form video, design day-to-day graphics and stories, brief bigger pieces to the designer in advance, and follow brand guidelines and approved product claims on every post. Nothing missed, nothing late.
 Creator content – Review the creator and UGC content coming in from our creator programs, repurpose the best of it for organic, and feed back to the creator team on what works.
 Community – Reply to all comments and DMs within 24 hours across both brands, keep the Facebook group active, engage with tagged mentions, and flag customer issues to Customer Support the same day.
 Planning and reporting – Post daily priorities, deliver a performance report every Monday (what worked, what didn't and what you're changing), set organic social KPI targets with the Influencers & Partnerships Manager and update them on the department scorecard weekly, and join the weekly team meeting.
 How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate
 (1) Application + Screening
 (2) Test Project
 (3) Technical Interview
 (4) Culture Fit Interview

 USD $3,000 – $4,500 per month (based on experience and expertise).

About Gusto 
 At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.
 All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .
 AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.
 About Design at Gusto: 
 Design at Gusto is made up of over 80 creative, collaborative people who care deeply about our mission to empower small businesses and their employees. We're a cross-functional group that is always looking for opportunities to build understanding and empathy for the people who use Gusto. We don't care much about swim lanes and though we care deeply about quality and craft, we are never precious about it. We work closely with cross-functional partners in Product, Engineering, Data, and Marketing to design, build, and ship experiences that make a real difference. We believe great design can make hard things possible, even delightful.
 We are building an AI-native design organization — and we mean that seriously. We're looking for designers who are already working this way: using AI to prototype ideas quickly, shorten customer feedback loops, and ship quality UX directly to customers. This isn't a future aspiration — it's how we work now, and it's changing what the design role looks like at Gusto and across the industry.
 About the Role: 
 For the hundreds of thousands of small businesses we serve, our mission starts with one of their most critical responsibilities: paying their team. Getting payroll right isn’t just a feature—it’s the foundation of trust with every business that relies on us. 
 As the Product Design Manager for Payroll, you'll lead design in this senior level position for one of Gusto's most complex and consequential product areas, shaping the future of a product that millions of people rely on for financial stability and personal prosperity. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with broad scope. You'll manage a team of designers and set the UX direction for Payroll, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, Ops, Compliance, and others to take on payroll complexity so our customers don't have to. 
 Your work will include simplifying complex, reciprocal workflows, defining a long-term UX vision and rallying others around it, and leading automation and AI initiatives that make the work of paying a team disappear. You'll also mentor designers, set the quality and judgment standard for AI-assisted design work across the broader Design team, and contribute to platform standards that help others across Gusto build consistent, high-quality experiences. 
 About the Team: 
 Payroll is the foundation of Gusto and our most-used, most-loved product. It’s the first Gusto experience many customers interact with, and it continues to power their success as they grow. Payroll also underpins our broader ecosystem, enabling the adoption of Benefits, Time Tracking, HR tools, and so much more. Our team is tasked with evolving and scaling this core experience for small businesses of all sizes, from solo entrepreneurs to growing companies. We focus on taking on the complexity of payroll so our customers don’t have to—making payroll faster, more flexible, and increasingly hands off. 
 Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day: 
 Lead end-to-end design for Payroll — shaping experiences that help small businesses pay their teams correctly, on time, and with confidence. 
 Define and communicate the long-term UX vision for Payroll, and rally multiple teams around it. 
 Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, Ops and others to set strategy and roadmaps. 
 Lead product initiatives where AI and automation are central to the user experience, simplifying payroll and reducing manual work without compromising accuracy or trust. 
 Collaborate with Research and Data to uncover customer insights and translate them into clear, actionable UX priorities. 
 Influence product and technical roadmaps by advocating for design quality, customer needs, and long-term system health. 
 Set the quality and judgment standard for all design work — whether AI-assisted or not — including when to push further and when outputs meet the bar. 
 Define and scale shared patterns, principles, and standards that promote quality, consistency, and velocity. 
 Manage and grow a team of designers, providing mentorship, clear direction, and hands-on support across the team. 
 Champion the Payroll experience as the foundation of Gusto's broader People Platform, ensuring seamless integration across Benefits, Time & Attendance, and third-party tools. 
 Here’s what we're looking for: 
 8–10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3 years leading and managing design teams. 
 Experience designing in complex domains i.e. financial products, healthcare, or similarly regulated environments. 
 Experience setting UX direction across multiple teams and influencing product strategy — not just executing on it. 
 Proven ability to drive alignment across cross-functional partners and represent design in high-stakes, strategic conversations. 
 Deep systems thinking, with a track record of turning interconnected, complex workflows into experiences that feel simple and intuitive. 
 Clear, direct communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain design decisions and influence partners at all levels. 
 A genuine bond to Gusto's mission and the needs of small businesses. 
 Ideally you have: 
 Demonstrated ability to assess AI-generated design directions: knowing when to use them, when to override them, and how to raise the quality bar on AI outputs.
 Experience leading product initiatives where AI or automation is central to the user experience — including how to represent uncertainty, surface errors gracefully, and preserve user agency when automation gets it wrong, particularly in high-stakes contexts.
 Experience leading a team through an AI workflow transition — not just adopting AI personally, but changing how a team works, including establishing new norms and standards.
 At Gusto, we strive to provide rewards that empower employees to achieve their financial and personal goals. We offer competitive compensation packages with a strong emphasis on equity based compensation (ownership in Gusto). To learn more about Gusto’s compensation philosophy and benefits offerings please view our Total Rewards Approach page.

 What is The Role

 This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building benchmarks and investigating performance, with technical publishing as a shared responsibility alongside engineering and content partners.

About the Role
 Birg is a holding company that builds companies. Four entities run on one connected system: Birg.co (the holding company), rthmc (the venture studio that takes technology companies from idea to scale), Interuum (the talent pool deployed across the group), and Birg Capital (the capital arm). 
 This role exists for one reason: so the CEO no longer has to be the guy in the room for execution to happen. You will lead the venture studio’s execution across the portfolio, launching concurrent ventures on system and to standard and scaling toward roughly ten live ventures by the end of 2027. You'll work directly with a repeat, exited founder whose leverage belongs on capital, partnerships, and the next opportunity — not on whether Venture 002 shipped on time. That part is yours.
 The machine handles the black-and-white on purpose, which is exactly why you can't be. We're looking for the operator who reads the signal beneath the noise, knows the entrepreneur from the wantpreneur on sight, and has the gravitas to hire and motivate Venture CEOs you'd put in front of a Fortune 500 board. Speed, operating rigor, and founder instinct rarely live in one person. When they do, that's this hire.
 Key Responsibilities
 Own the Machine
 Reach full fluency — fast — in how the group operates: every system, every venture, every gate.
 Own the operating system end to end and hold every venture to its M0 / M1 / M2 stage gates. Nothing progresses on momentum alone.
 Improve the system continuously as patterns emerge across the portfolio.
 Treat adherence to the system as non-negotiable — for yourself and everyone in it.
 Own Venture Execution
 Drive Venture 001 and Venture 002 from readiness to launch; plan and stage Venture 003.
 Make sequencing and prioritization calls independently — which venture to push, which to pause, before the dashboard says so.
 Be accountable for launches, on time and on system — not for tracking projects.
 Report signal, not activity, and surface risk early.
 Recruit & Motivate Venture Leadership
 Attract and hire Venture CEOs (or EIRs, where that's the better model) for Venture 001 and every venture that follows.
 Build the attract kit and compensation architecture that lands founder-caliber talent.
 Bring the gravitas and motivation that keeps venture leaders performing at pace.
 Run the Control Center
 Own the venture studio’s operating cadence: annual planning → quarterly mapping → monthly plans → weekly deliverables.
 Run execution in ClickUp (or equivalent) with real discipline; coordinate leadership calendars and build the rhythms that keep everyone in sync.
 Surface anything blocked or behind before the halfway mark — never at the deadline.
 Ensure each venture has the digital presence required for launch, working with the relevant growth and brand leads.
 Build the Team & the AI Layer
 Assess hiring needs across the portfolio and bring people in with the Head of People (HOP) through the systems already built.
 Default to AI agents before headcount; build and improve the AI operating layer that lets one operator oversee many ventures at once.
 Build lean, high-caliber teams only when the portfolio has earned them.
 Success Metrics
 First 30 days 
 Full fluency in the group and its systems — what's shipped, blocked, and at risk across Venture 001 and 002.
 A weekly operating cadence live across the portfolio.
 By 90 days 
 Birg.co and all subsidiary websites and online presence built and live.
 Venture 001 and 002 execution on track and on system; Venture 003 planned and staged.
 A repeatable reporting framework running; first Venture CEO / EIR search underway, with attract kit and compensation in place.
 6 months 
 Venture leadership placed and performing; hiring flowing through the systems with HOP.
 The control center running the portfolio on a predictable rhythm.
 12 months 
 Execution runs on systems, not on the CEO's oversight.
 Ventures launching on the same playbook, each faster than the last — on the path to ~10 live ventures by the end of 2027.
 The CEO makes portfolio and resourcing calls on your judgment without checking the underlying work.

 6+ years operating in startups, venture building, or general management — ideally across more than one company.
 Fractional / portfolio COO capability: you've run execution across multiple products or business lines at once, without a large team behind you.
 Owned at least one (ideally several) companies or products from zero to launch — your launch, not someone else's.
 Elite operating discipline: annual → quarterly → monthly → weekly, tracked in ClickUp or equivalent, with blockers escalated early. Authority without drama; clarity as kindness.
 Signal judgment: you separate signal from noise instinctively and know the entrepreneur from the wantrepreneur.
 AI-native: you use AI agents and agentic workflows to replace team-based work, not just to speed up your own.

 Venture studio, startup holding company, PE operating group, or other multi-entity experience.
 Built or scaled a B2B SaaS company.
 Recruited, hired, and managed founder-level talent (CEOs, EIRs).
 Built or directed a company's digital presence and brand from scratch.
 Founder with an exit, now wanting to operate at the portfolio level rather than found again.
 Core Competencies
 Operating Rigor 
 Cadence and systems that make execution predictable.
 Calendar orchestration and early blocker escalation across leadership.
 Venture Judgment 
 Signal-to-noise reading on live ventures.
 M0 / M1 / M2 gate discipline, earned progression, never momentum.
 Leadership Gravitas 
 Recruits and motivates founder-caliber talent.
 Runs teams hard and clean, because clarity is kindness.

 HIGHLY PREFERRED

 Experience building or scaling a B2B SaaS company.
 Experience implementing structured venture-building frameworks, including stage-gate models, venture operating systems, or similar methodologies.

 Founder experience (successful exit or otherwise) and a desire to operate at the portfolio level rather than founding another company.

 Has built more than one company from zero and can clearly explain what changed with each experience.
 Treats venture outcomes as personally owned rather than escalating responsibility upward.
 Defaults to AI agents before requesting additional headcount.
 Gives the CEO bad news early—before it becomes a crisis.
 Can enforce a system rigorously while exercising sound judgment when the system alone isn't enough.
 Builds only the team the portfolio has genuinely earned.
 CANDIDATE SNAPSHOT
 Founder-minded operator with multiple zero-to-one experiences.
 Fluent in AI as a core operating capability, not just a productivity tool.
 Comfortable owning execution across a portfolio with significant autonomy.
 Motivated by building, learning, and compounding impact rather than titles or hierarchy.

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
 About the Role 
 We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and execution for a key product area within the Auth0 Identity Security product line, with a focused mandate on the rapidly evolving domain of Agentic Security. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, cross-functional leadership, and agile execution — requiring someone who can both shape long-term direction and deliver with precision.
 We are the team that builds solutions that protect our customer’s Auth0 environments. Our group delivers features such as attack protection, bot detection, adaptive MFA, identity security for AI Agents and related analytics / insights on the effectiveness of our solutions in thwarting attacks from bad actors.
 The ideal candidate brings direct, hands-on experience in agentic security product management, with a deep understanding of how AI agents are built, orchestrated, and secured. This includes practical knowledge of agentic workflows, MCP servers, agentic tooling, and their use through productivity applications such as Claude Code.
 A core focus of this role is runtime security & AI agent classification: building real-time detection, behavioral analysis, and protection capabilities for agentic systems. The successful candidate will have command of the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic AI attack vectors and mitigations, and will bring experience in identifying and responding to threats such as prompt injection, agent intent anomalies, and rogue agent detection — including scenarios where an agent may have been compromised or infiltrated.
 Beyond agentic-native threats, this role demands strong fluency in fraud and risk mitigation, spanning both traditional and emerging attack surfaces. This includes a depth of knowledge across classic vectors — Account Takeover (ATO), resource draining, and fraudulent account creation — as well as their evolving equivalents in multi-agent and autonomous system environments.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and champion a clear product strategy and roadmap, utilizing data-driven prioritization methods to maximize customer value and business impact. Manage inputs from diverse cross-functional stakeholders.
 Customer Experience: Drive customer research (surveys, interviews, data analysis) to identify top opportunities, optimize the end-to-end customer journey, and ensure product value realization.
 Experience Design: Partner with Product Design on prototypes, wireframes, and concepts, continuously improving the usability of both the UI and APIs for technical and business audiences.
 Agile Execution & Delivery: Maintain active, daily collaboration with engineering teams. Write clear user stories, scope work for sprints, and actively participate in Agile cadences. Proactively solve problems and manage ambiguity to ensure on-time delivery.
 Performance Optimization: Drive continuous data analysis and insights into customer adoption. Establish clear hypotheses and baselines for feature launches, then track progress toward strategic targets and drive continuous product iteration based on learnings.
 Commercial Growth & Value: Partner closely with Product Marketing to run targeted customer campaigns. These efforts will drive trial conversions, accelerate Product-Led Growth (PLG) motions, boost retention, and increase high-value usage and adoption.
 Go-to-Market: Proactively monitor the competitive landscape to identify gaps and differentiators. Partner with Product Marketing and pre-sales engineering to refine product positioning, develop engaging customer value messaging, and craft supporting content (blogs, webinars).
 Field & Customer Engagement: Actively engage with the field organization (Sales, Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Managers) to build deep knowledge of the voice of the customer. Drive customer conversations during pre-sales, renewals, and at key events to gather feedback and support adoption.
 AI-Powered Productivity: Drive efficiency and strategic insight by leveraging AI tools for high-value activities, including prototyping, synthesizing customer insights, accelerating competitive and market analysis, and rapidly generating high-quality product documentation.
 Required Qualifications 
 AI Agent Experience: Significant product experience with AI Agent creation, orchestration and the use of MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for exposing context, tools, and resources to agents. Ability to use this experience to define how Auth0's should securely authenticate, authorize, and monitor non-human AI principals at runtime.
 Agentic Threat Remediation: You have a strong command of the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic AI, and can articulate how each attack class manifests in real-world agentic deployments. You bring direct experience identifying, triaging, and driving remediation of agentic threats, with particular depth in: prompt injection attacks, agent intent anomalies, and rogue agent detection. 
 Product Management Experience: 5-8 years of experience in Product Management, whether from startup or high-growth company environments. 
 Education : An Undergraduate and/or Masters Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related technical field.
 General Security Industry Experience : Prior working experience in the security, fraud or compliance industries with foundational knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM/CIAM) concepts (e.g., OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SSO, MFA, RBAC) and/or familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to identity security (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2).
 Communication : Excellent communication skills (presentation, verbal, and written) and a highly collaborative approach, working with cross-functional stakeholders across the organization.
 Enterprise Software : Demonstrated experience in delivery of global, enterprise software across all aspects of the product lifecycle.
 Results Driven : A clear history of being outcome-driven and achieving tangible business results through the successful delivery of products, features, or capabilities that you have owned.
 Problem Solving : Keen analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities, with a proven capacity to formulate effective action plans even when faced with incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous inputs.
 Entrepreneurial : Bring an entrepreneurial mindset and a strong intellectual curiosity that drives you to learn and delve deeply into both business and technical aspects of this role.
 Agile Development : Deep experience working successfully with engineering teams in an Agile development environment, including scoping, sprint planning, and backlog management and prioritization.

 We're revolutionizing commerce from port to doorstep with Burq Intelligence.
 Burq started with an ambitious mission: to turn the complex process of offering delivery into a simple, turnkey solution. It's a big mission, and now we want you to join us in making it even bigger.
 We're proud to be recognized as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators and a 2025 Inc. Magazine Power Partner, awards that highlight how we're redefining the future of logistics while empowering our partners to grow.
 Backed by leading Silicon Valley investors like Village Global, the fund whose investors include Bill Gates, Jeff Bezos, Mark Zuckerberg, Reid Hoffman, and Sara Blakely, we've built a world-class team across the globe.
 We operate at scale but remain small enough for every person to have a massive impact. There's a lot of important work ahead, and joining Burq means the opportunity to grow faster than ever while doing the most meaningful work of your career.
 The role
 We're hiring a Staff ML/OR engineer to define and build the intelligence at the core of Dispatch OS, our platform for ML-assisted dispatch decisions. You'll set the technical direction for how Burq prices, selects, forecasts, and routes deliveries, and you'll personally build the highest-leverage models and optimization systems behind it.
 You'll own the architecture and roadmap for ML and optimization across the platform, make the key technical bets, and raise the bar for how we build, evaluate, and ship models. This is a hands-on IC role with company-level impact on revenue, margin, and delivery reliability.
 What you'll do
 Technical leadership
 Technical direction: own the ML and optimization roadmap for Dispatch OS, deciding which problems get ML, which get solvers, which stay heuristic, and in what order
 Architecture: design the end-to-end architecture for model serving, evaluation, and optimization so it scales with order volume, new providers, and new customers
 Hardest problems: lead the most ambiguous, high-stakes modeling and optimization problems from framing through production, and guide technical work across Engineering and Data
 Raise the bar: set standards for experimentation, evaluation, and production ML, and mentor engineers through design reviews, pairing, and code review
 Strategic partnership: work with Product and leadership to shape product strategy and identify where ML and OR create competitive advantage
 Core systems
 Quote selection and pricing: design and ship models for quote selection, dynamic pricing, and reliability scoring that measurably improve margin, win rate, and conversion
 Forecasting: build demand and volume forecasting models, including modern deep learning approaches where they outperform classical methods, to - help operations and customers plan driver and fleet capacity
 Optimization: move dispatch decisions from heuristics to solver-based optimization for batching, route optimization, and vehicle/fleet recommendation, using OR-Tools, Gurobi, or similar where it earns its keep

À PROPOS DU POSTE

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Gestionnaire de produit principal (Principal Product Manager) exceptionnel pour bâtir la place de marché API de HTS — la couche commerciale et orientée développeurs par laquelle nos partenaires entreprises accèdent aux capacités d'hébergement et de location de voitures de Hopper.

Il s'agit d'un véritable rôle « 0 à 1 ». Vous serez la personne qui définit le produit : comment les capacités sont regroupées et tarifées, comment les partenaires les découvrent et les intègrent, et comment la place de marché évolue en tant que plateforme d'affaires. Les capacités techniques sous-jacentes — orchestration de la connectivité, tarification et tri, cartographie de contenu, extranet — sont détenues par des équipes de capacités dédiées. Votre rôle est de travailler en étroite collaboration avec ces gestionnaires de produits (PM) pour comprendre, packager et exposer commercialement ces capacités sous forme de produits API cohérents et de calibre entreprise.

Nous attendons de ce PM qu'il agisse rapidement avec agilité (scrappily). Vous devez être à l'aise avec les outils d'IA et la programmation intuitive (vibe coding) pour prototyper des flux de travail, simuler des API et tester l'expérience des partenaires avant de passer le relais à l'ingénierie. Le candidat idéal privilégiera toujours un prototype avant un document d’exigences produit (PRD).

Vous collaborerez avec les équipes d'ingénierie, de science des données, commerciales, financières et d'approvisionnement — et vous coordonnerez étroitement avec d'autres PM à travers l'organisation — pour faire passer la place de marché du concept à une plateforme génératrice de revenus.



Ce poste est entièrement en télétravail.



RESPONSABILITÉS

 - Définir la place de marché API de HTS : structurer, packager et tarifer les capacités d'un portefeuille incluant HTS Connect, les polygones de recherche, l'autocomplétion, le classement, la cartographie de contenu et de propriétés, la cartographie de chambres, la déduplication/enchères, la tarification, l'extranet, les taxes et le moteur d'accords personnalisés.

 - Coordonner avec les PM de capacités : comprendre la feuille de route, les contraintes et les possibilités de personnalisation des systèmes techniques sous-jacents, et les traduire en produits API consommables à l'externe.

 - Gérer le modèle commercial : prendre les décisions entre frais de plateforme et frais variables, définir la structure de commission (take rate) par capacité, le packaging entreprise et le cadre d'accords personnalisés pour les grands partenaires.

 - Bâtir l'expérience développeur et partenaire à partir de zéro : spécifications d'API, flux d'intégration des partenaires, normes de documentation, environnements bac à sable (sandbox) et outils d'intégration minimisant le délai de rentabilisation.

 - Établir la stratégie de mise en marché (GTM) : identifier les bons partenaires, séquencer les lancements et définir les critères de succès commerciaux.

 À propos du Centre de santé communautaire Côte-de-Sable 
 Depuis plus de 50 ans, le Centre de santé communautaire Côte-de-Sable (CSCCS) met les soins de santé au service de la communauté. En tant qu’organisme sans but lucratif gouverné par la communauté, nous estimons que la santé ne se résume pas au traitement des maladies. Elle passe aussi par la lutte contre les obstacles sociaux, économiques et systémiques qui affectent la santé et le bien-être des personnes.
 Grâce à une vaste gamme de services interdisciplinaires en soins de santé primaires, en santé mentale et en consommation de substances, ainsi qu’en promotion de la santé, en réduction des méfaits, en développement communautaire et en soutien social, le CSCCS accompagne des personnes et des familles issues de milieux divers, en portant une attention particulière à celles et ceux qui se heurtent à des obstacles à l’accès aux soins. Guidé par ses valeurs d’intégrité, de respect, d’équité, de collaboration et d’empathie , le CSCCS s’engage à offrir des services accessibles, empreints de compassion et axés sur la personne, qui tiennent compte de l’évolution des besoins de la communauté.
 Notre organisation repose avant tout sur une équipe de professionnel·le·s aux profils variés, qui conjuguent expertise, bienveillance et engagement profond envers les personnes et les communautés que nous accompagnons. Notre vision est simple, mais porteuse de sens : tous les membres de notre communauté auront un accès équitable à la santé et au bien-être. 
 Le poste 
 À l’approche du départ à la retraite de notre PDG, le conseil d’administration recherche une personne expérimentée, bienveillante et dotée d’un esprit de collaboration pour assurer la direction du CSCCS et l’accompagner dans un nouveau chapitre de son histoire. 
 Relevant du conseil d’administration, le/la PDG assurera le leadership stratégique et opérationnel d’un organisme complexe et multidisciplinaire. Il/elle s’appuiera sur les atouts et l’expérience développés au fil des ans, tout en veillant à ce que le CSCCS puisse répondre efficacement à l’évolution des besoins de la communauté, aux priorités du système de santé et aux réalités du financement.
 La personne retenue devra démontrer une connaissance approfondie des services de santé et des services sociaux offerts en milieu communautaire, et justifier d’une expérience avérée en gestion organisationnelle, en gestion financière, en gestion des ressources humaines et en gouvernance. Elle devra également être en mesure de mobiliser et de soutenir une équipe aux profils variés, de favoriser une culture organisationnelle saine et inclusive, de renforcer les partenariats et de promouvoir des services de qualité, équitables et adaptés aux besoins de la communauté.
 Nous recherchons une personne qui incarne les valeurs du Centre et qui soit présente et accessible  ; une personne qui soit à l’écoute, qui sache établir des relations de confiance et reconnaître la compétence des autres, tout en faisant preuve de discernement, de sens des responsabilités et de détermination face à des enjeux complexes. La prochaine présidence direction générale devra veiller à préserver ce qui fait la singularité du CSCCS, tout en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec le personnel, le conseil d’administration et les partenaires communautaires afin d’assurer la pérennité de l’organisme et de soutenir son développement.
 Ce poste permet de prendre la direction d’un centre de santé communautaire bien établi et reconnu, et de contribuer concrètement au mieux-être de la communauté grâce à un leadership éclairé, à des relations solides et à un engagement envers la justice sociale.
 Le CSCCS invite les personnes qualifiées, à l’interne comme à l’externe, qui partagent ses valeurs et souhaitent contribuer à l’amélioration de la santé et du bien-être des communautés qu’il dessert, à soumettre leur candidature.
 Compétences, formation et expérience requises 
 Les critères à remplir pour ce poste sont les suivants :
 Formation 
 Maîtrise ou formation universitaire de deuxième cycle ou plus
 Expérience professionnelle 
 Cinq ans d’expérience ou plus dans un poste de cadre supérieur, de préférence au sein d’un organisme sans but lucratif, d’une ONG ou dans le secteur de la santé
 Expérience de travail auprès d’un conseil communautaire et dans un environnement structuré en comités
 Connaissance des différentes responsabilités liées à la gestion et expérience dans les domaines suivants : gestion financière, ressources humaines, élaboration et évaluation de programmes, planification stratégique et droit du travail, ainsi qu’une bonne compréhension des enjeux actuels en matière de gestion
 Compétences clés 
 Bonne compréhension des principes de gouvernance communautaire et de la participation citoyenne
 Bonne compréhension des différentes activités de promotion de la santé et connaissance du système de santé à Ottawa, en Ontario et au Canada
 Connaissance des enjeux actuels liés à la réforme du système de santé
 Excellentes aptitudes relationnelles
 Grande capacité d’analyse
 Aptitude à gérer et à résoudre les conflits
 Compétences linguistiques 
 Dans le cadre de la désignation du Centre pour la prestation de services en français :
 Français ‒ expression orale : niveau avancé
